messages:
Taylor: Weather forecast says 60% chance of rain on Saturday. Thinking: soggy picnic with board games under a tarp or a cozy movie marathon at my place. Thoughts? :umbrella: :popcorn:
Ivy: Rainy day = movie marathon. I will bring a suspiciously large thermos of tea. :tea:
Ben: Picnic + tarp is tempting but Im out for the tarp assembly. Movie night sounds safer. Also can bring my portable speaker.
Rocio: I vote movie marathon but with an outdoor interlude if the rain holds off. Also can bring my friends projector if we need big-screen vibes.
Taylor: Poll: P for picnic (tarp plan) or M for movie. Reply P or M. Ill lock in by 6pm.
Ben: M
Ivy: M
Rocio: M (but bring a folding chair just in case)
Taylor: OK movie marathon it is. Plan: my living room, Saturday 2pm. Bring blankets, snacks, and those weird layered dip things. Calendar invite incoming.
calendar-bot: Event created by Taylor: "Saturday Movie + Snacks" 024-06-15 14:00 024-06-15 18:00 Attendees: Taylor, Ivy, Ben, Rocio.
Ivy: Ill bring the thermos and a black licorice-free snack bag.
Ben: Ill bring cords + speaker. Rocio: projector and extra HDMI. Taylor: soundtrack ready?
Taylor: Playlist queued. If anyone has a last-minute picnic urge, we can do a popcorn break on the balcony. :movie_camera:
